Lee Chen: Adding a silly one: early 2000s indie mixtape = rereading travel guides. also uploading a shelf pic in a sec.
Samir Bhat: Shelf photo incoming. Poll: album or book that changed your weekend vibe? I vote album.
Cassie (spotify-bot): shared playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX6ziWCZRJ9yD (curated: "shelf-escape")
